aboutText: For over 15 years, Braybrook Flooring Specialists has been the go-to store for all flooring needs in Braybrook. We offer a wide range of tiles, hardwood, and vinyl flooring, with expert installation services. Our local team understands the styles and requirements of Braybrook homes and businesses, ensuring perfect results every time.
servicesText: We provide comprehensive flooring solutions, including professional installation for tiles, timber, and vinyl. Our services cover everything from initial consultation to final fitting, ensuring a seamless experience for Braybrook residents.

services.title: Tile Installation
services.desc: Expert laying of ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles for kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas.

services.title: Hardwood Flooring
services.desc: Supply and installation of premium timber flooring with custom finishes to match your home.

services.title: Vinyl & Laminate
services.desc: Durable and stylish vinyl and laminate options for high-traffic areas, with professional fitting.

services.title: Carpet Supply & Fit
services.desc: Wide range of carpets from wool to synthetic, including professional measurement and installation.

services.title: Underfloor Heating
services.desc: Installation of underfloor heating systems for cosy, efficient warmth throughout your home.

services.title: Flooring Repairs
services.desc: Repair and restoration of damaged floors, including scratches, dents, and water damage issues.
